title: drive fix round on a solo sprint escalates spawn_failed: plan names no builder role
detail: cost-budget (solo, no design/<f>/plan.md): conventions FAILed in reviewing, drive ran 'gate fix-round start' then _builders() (drive.py:421) read plan.md for a builder role and raised spawn_failed. A solo sprint's fix round has no route: it should hand back like solo_handback (or spawn the solo builder), not fail on a missing plan. Also: the regression reviewer's suite run recreates __pycache__/.ruff_cache in worktrees/solo, which the conventions reviewer then flags as leaked artifacts - reviewers manufacturing each other's findings.
